name: HTTPS endpoint reachable
preconditions: HTTPS origin can be derived from project origin.
pass_condition: TLS connection succeeds and an HTTP response is obtained.
fail_condition: DNS, connection, or TLS/certificate failure prevents the HTTPS endpoint from returning an HTTP response.
unknown_condition: fetch was required but no usable acquisition result was produced.

name: Robots access matches explicit crawl intent
preconditions: robots.txt parsed; expected_crawlable=true explicitly supplied.
pass_condition: URL is allowed for the evaluated crawler.
fail_condition: explicit expected_crawlable=true and effective robots policy disallows the URL.
unknown_condition: effective robots decision cannot be obtained.
not_applicable_condition: crawl intent was not explicitly supplied.

name: HTTP status matches explicit expected URL state
preconditions: expected_url_state is explicitly live, redirect, or missing.
fail_condition: obtained response does not match the explicitly supplied expected state.

name: Unexpected server-error response
preconditions: HTTP response obtained.

name: Googlebot robots access matches explicit policy
preconditions: Googlebot robots policy is parseable.
pass_condition: explicit allow/block policy matches effective robots behavior.
warning_condition: Googlebot is disallowed while project policy is unspecified.
fail_condition: explicit Googlebot access policy exists and effective robots behavior contradicts it.
unknown_condition: effective Googlebot robots state cannot be calculated.

name: Googlebot profile response anomaly
preconditions: normal and Googlebot-profile requests attempted.
pass_condition: equivalent accessible response classes and no bot-only challenge observed.
warning_condition: Googlebot-profile request receives 403/429/challenge not observed for normal request.
guardrail: this is an observed profile difference, not proof of actual Googlebot access.

name: Blocked CSS/JS resource affects rendered output
preconditions: CSS/JS resource referenced by selected rendered page.
pass_condition: resource accessible, or blocked without observed material audited-output dependency.
warning_condition: resource blocked but material rendering impact cannot be established.
fail_condition: resource blocked and direct render evidence proves loss/change of audited main content or metadata because the resource is unavailable.

name: Bot-profile access restriction observed
preconditions: normal and alternate bot-profile requests completed.
warning_condition: alternate profile receives 403/429/challenge while normal profile remains accessible.
guardrail: no verified crawler-blocking claim without verified bot identity/log evidence.

name: Effective noindex conflicts with explicit indexability intent
preconditions: expected_indexable=true explicitly supplied.

name: Conflicting index directives
preconditions: at least one applicable directive parsed.
pass_condition: no contradictory index/noindex intent in the same applicable scope.
fail_condition: contradictory index and noindex directives explicitly present in the same applicable scope.
unknown_condition: directives present but not reliably parseable.

name: Malformed or unsupported robots directive
preconditions: meta robots or X-Robots-Tag exists.
pass_condition: all directive tokens are recognized by the supported V1 directive registry.

name: Known-missing probe resolves to 404/410
preconditions: audit generated a collision-resistant URL expected not to exist.
fail_condition: usable final response is obtained but final status is not 404/410.

name: Snippet restriction conflicts with snippet policy
preconditions: snippet directives extracted.
pass_condition: no restriction exists, or explicit policy permits observed restriction.
warning_condition: restriction exists while snippet policy is unspecified.
fail_condition: snippet_policy=allow_unrestricted and a snippet restriction is present.
manual_review_condition: restriction scope requires human interpretation, e.g. block-level data-nosnippet.
not_applicable_condition: explicit policy intentionally requires observed restriction.
guardrail: relaxing snippet controls never guarantees AI citation.

name: 200 response matches known 404 template
preconditions: target is 200; known missing probe returned 404/410 and its fingerprint was captured.
pass_condition: target fingerprint differs from known 404-template fingerprint.
warning_condition: target returns 200 and exactly matches known 404-template fingerprint.

name: Origin variants normalize to preferred origin
preconditions: explicit preferred origin; evaluated non-preferred variant returns an HTTP response.
pass_condition: non-preferred variant permanently redirects via 301/308 to preferred origin.
warning_condition: preferred origin reached only through temporary redirect.
fail_condition: non-preferred variant remains 2xx or resolves to a different origin.

name: Trailing-slash pair is consistently normalized
preconditions: both variants evaluable.
pass_condition: one variant is final 2xx and the alternative permanently redirects directly to it.
warning_condition: both are 2xx but hashes differ, or normalization is inconsistent without proving duplication.
fail_condition: both variants are 2xx with identical normalized content hashes.

name: Canonical declaration missing
preconditions: final response is 2xx HTML.
pass_condition: at least one canonical declaration present.

name: Multiple canonical declarations
preconditions: at least one canonical declaration exists.
warning_condition: multiple declarations normalize to the same target.
fail_condition: more than one distinct normalized canonical target.

name: Canonical URL is syntactically resolvable
preconditions: exactly one canonical declaration exists.
pass_condition: value resolves to valid HTTP(S) URL.
fail_condition: value cannot be resolved as a valid canonical URL.

name: Canonical target returns final 200
preconditions: exactly one valid canonical target and target fetch attempted.

name: Canonical target is not noindex
preconditions: canonical target is 200 and index directives extracted.

name: Redirect chain exceeds one hop
preconditions: initial response redirects.
pass_condition: exactly one redirect reaches final destination.
fail_condition: two or more redirect hops occur before final destination.

name: Redirect loop detected
preconditions: at least one redirect occurs.
unknown_condition: traversal incomplete before loop state determined.

name: Redirect final target is available
preconditions: redirect exists and no loop detected.

name: Pagination exposes crawlable next-page link
preconditions: paginated sequence identified and current URL not final page.
pass_condition: next page exposed through crawlable <a href>.
warning_condition: next page appears to depend only on script/event/infinite-scroll interaction.

name: Internal navigation target lacks crawlable href
preconditions: internal navigation candidate has resolvable target.
pass_condition: target represented by <a href> with usable URL.
warning_condition: navigation works through another mechanism but no crawlable href exposed.

name: Internal link targets 3xx
preconditions: resolved target is internal and fetchable.

name: Internal link targets 4xx
preconditions: resolved target is internal and fetchable.

name: Internal link targets 5xx
preconditions: resolved target is internal and fetchable.

name: Orphan candidate relative to supplied discovery sources
preconditions: URL is in at least one supplied non-crawl source and is not crawl start URL.
pass_condition: at least one crawlable internal inlink found.
guardrail: wording must remain “orphan relative to supplied discovery sources”.

name: Priority-page crawl depth review
preconditions: priority_page=true explicitly supplied.
manual_review_condition: preconditions met; surface depth/path with no universal threshold.
unknown_condition: depth unavailable due incomplete discovery/crawl evidence.

name: Sitemap presence matches project policy
preconditions: root/robots sitemap discovery sources evaluated.
pass_condition: one or more sitemap URLs discovered.

name: Sitemap document returns 200
preconditions: sitemap discovered or explicitly supplied.

name: Sitemap is parseable
preconditions: sitemap returned 200 and body retrieved.
pass_condition: parses as supported sitemap or sitemap index.

name: Sitemap-listed URL returns final 200
preconditions: URL parsed from sitemap.

name: Sitemap-listed URL is not noindex
preconditions: listed URL is 200 and directives extractable.
not_applicable_condition: listed URL not usable 200 HTML target.

name: Sitemap-listed URL canonicalizes to itself when canonical is declared
preconditions: listed URL declares exactly one valid canonical.

name: Structured-data block parses successfully
preconditions: JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa block detected.
pass_condition: block parses successfully in supported parser.
guardrail: V1 does not infer page-type appropriateness or special GEO schema requirements.

name: Title changes after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: Canonical changes after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: Robots directives change after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: H1 set changes after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: Main-text presence changes after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: Crawlable internal-link set changes after render
preconditions: raw and rendered observations are available for a URL selected for rendering.
unknown_condition: rendering requested but required raw/rendered evidence unavailable.
guardrail: never convert an observed raw/render difference into “Google cannot render this page” without platform-specific evidence.

name: OAI-SearchBot robots access matches project policy
preconditions: OAI-SearchBot robots policy can be evaluated.
pass_condition: explicit allow/block policy matches effective robots behavior.
warning_condition: OAI-SearchBot blocked while project policy unspecified.
fail_condition: explicit project policy exists and robots configuration contradicts it.
guardrail: FAIL means configuration contradicts explicit project policy; it is not a ChatGPT ranking/citation failure.

name: OAI-SearchBot profile encounters access anomaly
preconditions: default and OAI-profile requests attempted.
warning_condition: OAI profile receives 403/429/challenge while normal request does not.
guardrail: user-agent profile is not verified crawler identity.

name: GPTBot configuration matches explicit training policy
preconditions: GPTBot robots state can be evaluated.
pass_condition: explicit allow/block training policy matches effective GPTBot robots behavior.
warning_condition: explicit training policy conflicts with actual GPTBot configuration.
guardrail: GPTBot blocked can be PASS when policy is to block; it never implies ChatGPT Search is blocked.
